# Tomatoes

## Varieties

Gardener's Delight for cherry tomatoes, Marmande for slicing. Both did well in the greenhouse last year.

## Feeding

Feed with a high potash liquid once the first truss has set, then every ten days. Stop feeding when the fruit starts to colour.

## Problems

Blossom end rot shows up as a dark patch on the base of the fruit. It comes from uneven watering, not disease.
